title: Tanuki-Bayashi in the Forest
description: You learn that an old friend of Hanachirusato's can be found in Chinju Forest. Perhaps they might be able to help out with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. But while in the forest, you hear a strange shout.

mainQuestExcel.title: Tanuki-Bayashi in the Forest
mainQuestExcel.description: You learn that an old friend of Hanachirusato's can be found in Chinju Forest. Perhaps they might be able to help out with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. But while in the forest, you hear a strange shout.

dialogs.text: The Sky Kitsune Statue that was supposed to protect the ward... It's empty inside.
Maybe it was hidden by Miss Mask's old friend. Let's go find out!
"Miss Mask," Paimon?
Paimon just came up with that nickname. How is it? Easier to remember, right?
Not at all.
Well, forget it then... Anyway, let's find some clues first!
It makes no sense.

flow.stepDescription: Search for the source of the strange voice

dialogs.text: We're finally here! This must be the Chinju Forest.
Miss Masked Maiden said that an old friend of hers is in here.
Well, let's get moving!

flow.stepDescription: Search for the source of the strange voice

dialogs.text: The Sky Kitsune Statue that was supposed to protect the ward... It's empty inside.
Maybe it was hidden by Miss Mask's old friend. Let's go find out!
"Miss Mask," Paimon?
Paimon just came up with that nickname. How is it? Easier to remember, right?
Not at all.
Well, forget it then... Anyway, let's find some clues first!
It makes no sense.
Eek! I—I... Mine name is Ioroi. Do whatever you want! K—Kill me if that be your will!
Wow, the statue is talking! And it's so scared that it can barely string a sentence together!
I am no statue! This unseemly appearance is but the work of a temporary seal! Mine name is Ioroi, the world-renowned bake-danuki!
Ioroi?
What? Are you telling me that folk nowadays have heard naught of Ioroi?
The "Tanuki Gyouen Scroll," "Ioroi's Teapot," "Kakushigami Oobayashi," "Yougou Tanuki Gassen"... Of these tales have you heard nothing?
Ah, how long has mine seal persisted...
I mean you no harm...
What? You aren't here to destroy me? Come now, why did you not say so earlier, then?
*cough* Ahem. Well then, speak! Why have you come seeking me, the lord of bake-danuki?
This is about the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual...
The Sacred Secular what now? What is that? Some manner of oni treasure?
This guy is unbelievable...
*sigh* Is he really Miss Masked Maiden's old friend?
Anyway, we're looking for something hidden inside a kitsune statue.
Eek... Uh, Wh—Why are you l—looking for that, might I ask?
Ah.
Ugh, it's on that comb's account that I was sealed in here for...
One hundred years?
I don't know how long it's been! Sunlight doesn't come through the Chinju Forest. There's no way to tell time!
Back then, I wreaked havoc everywhere to lure that sneaky kitsune out, but it was all in vain.
Eventually, I decided to vent my anger by dismantling one of those kitsune statues, and I found a comb inside... Which gave me an idea!
The comb was hidden inside a kitsune statue and even had the Hakushin symbol on it, which reminded me of her white fur...
Thus, I concluded immediately that it must be very important. In which case, I just needed to hide the comb, and that sneaky kitsune would surely come out!
Yup, treasure's a good way to lure people out for sure! Then what happened?
Then came one of the humans from the Yougou Three. He defeated my tribe and I, turning all of us to stone.
So that's why Ioroi is afraid of humans...
Hmph! Humans. They're so short-lived, and they can't even transform... I don't get why that kitsune likes them so much.
That guy who sealed me up was especially infuriating. He even told me to "strike a nice pose so that I can become nice scenery." Why, that little—!
Well, you do make for nice scenery...
Eh? You... How could you...
#(Hey, {NICKNAME}, don't annoy him, or we may never get that ward...)
I mean to say that you look really bold and burly...
That's right! You make this dark forest look so much more colorful!
And?
Like the statue of a god...
Well, so, being sealed up is not such a bad thing after all, eh? See, humans don't mean you any harm!
I reckon I can see where you're going, but at the same time... I also... don't?
Could we borrow that comb you spoke of?
Well, you certainly could... But only if you play with the children first.
#Sure, that's easy. {NICKNAME} is good with kids!
Am I really...
Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, and Kichiboushi. Go find these <color=#00E1FFFF>three little tanuki</color> and play with them. I would do it, but as you can see, I'm not exactly at any liberty to move.
That dratted fellow was a bit sloppy when he sealed them. That's why some of them were able to get out earlier.
...Wait, that's not correct! We should say, rather, that we bake-danuki are most powerful indeed. It's only normal, therefore, that we could free ourselves from a mere human seal!
Well, what about you then...
Ahem! You speak truth, Ioroi the mighty and powerful!
Although their power can't really compare to mine, they can still use it to hide themselves.
Alright then, off you go.
Indeed, most powerful!
That's right, I play with Paimon all the time.
Hey!
Even the Statues of The Seven pale in comparison...
I mean that you are truly handsome and truly...
One thousand years?
One million years?
Now we're getting somewhere.
I'm looking for wards here...
Warts? Are those edible? We bake-danuki do know quite a bit about cooking.
No, it's the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual!
Victuals? Oh, it's been too long since I've had any victuals...
I am here to collect a debt.
Uh, collect a debt? Where? When was that? Let me think, let me think...
You, uh... What do I owe you, again?
He's thinking really hard...
You probably shouldn't tell this sort of joke in front of strangers.
That's right, jest not so!
Mm, it's all good, it's all good... Actually, best I make sure. Do I really owe you nothing?
...Do you really owe that many debts?
World-renowned?
Ooh... I do so wish to scratch mine belly...
Mm? You're back already? Go on, help me find Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, and Kichiboushi, and go <color=#00E1FFFF>play with them.</color>
Alright then, off you go.
Ooh... I do so wish to scratch mine belly...
Mm? You're back already? Go on, help me find Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, and Kichiboushi, and go <color=#00E1FFFF>play with them.</color>
Alright then, off you go.
Hehe, well done! They seem to be quite happy.
...Huh? Oh, no problem. Let me ask them for you.
Gyoubu Koban was asking, "If you are humans, why do you smell like tanuki?"
...Actually, that's right! I demand an explanation! Why *do* you smell like tanuki?
Eh? You're only asking this now...
It was the masked shrine maiden...
Right! That's what happened!
Miss Masked Maiden cooked us a very lavish meal earlier, and she said that she used magic she secretly learned from the bake-danuki to make it.
What? She learned our magic in secret? How dare she...
Hmm... Could it be...
Oh, come on. That sneaky kitsune! If she was still alive, she could at least have come over to say hello, right?
She's a shrine maiden with a mask, and she called you an "old friend."
Mask? I don't know anyone with a mask. Don't know any shrine maidens, either. I sure do know a kitsune, though.
...That said, that sneaky kitsune did appear in the form of a shrine maiden before. What does the shrine maiden you speak of look like?
She wears a white fox mask...
Anything else?
She had short black hair.
And she wore a shrine maiden outfit.
Hmm... Don't know her. Never seen anyone like that in mine life!
Is that so...
...Mm? Yeah, sure, leave it to me.
Shousei said, "It was fun playing with you. Thanks!"
Paimon had a lot of fun too!
So, about that comb...
Now, now — I am the world renowned bake-danuki Ioroi, and I will surely keep my word. You may have the comb.
But what do you plan to do with the comb, anyway? It probably still smells like kitsune.
Well, here's what happened...
She was dressed as a shrine maiden.
And she had short black hair!
We ate some strange stuff...
What? Weren't you off to enjoy your Sacred Secular Steaming Victuals or whatever?
Go now. If you run into that sneaky kitsune, remember to send her my regards.
What? I didn't realize that it was so important. You should've said so earlier...
Agh, I was sealed over this thing for...
One hundred years?
Ugh! Stop speaking so lightly of my misfortunes!
Never mind. It's all water under the bridge now. I do also have some inkling about the barrier near the forest.
Back when I was fighting that sneaky kitsune, I once saw it on the eastern seashore. It looks like a Thunder Sakura with a torii gate, right?
Back when that guy was battling the demons or whatever, I was worried that some of them might come out to hurt us. So I used magic to put a seal on that place.
Let me see. The seal should be under the cliff face to the east... Kichiboushi, take them there and remove the seal.
Thank you, Ioroi.
Alright, alright. Enough jibber-jabber. Go now.
If you run into that sneaky kitsune, remember to send her my regards. Just say... let me think...

"You've ticked me off real good this time, you jerk. Come back and fight me — our contest isn't over yet! And help me break this seal while you're at it, would you? It's not as if I couldn't do it myself or anything, but you still owe me a favor! Also, Gyoubu Koban says he misses you!"
Whoa, whoa, that's a lot to remember!
One thousand years?
One million years?

flow.stepDescription: Head to the location of the barrier

This is it? It's just a bunch of bare stones...
Hmm? He seems to be using some kind of magic to...
Whoa! The stones disappeared!
That's amazing.
So this is bake-danuki magic? Seems kinda fun!
Thank you, Kichiboushi! Let's play Hide-and-Seek next time.
Mm!
That's kinda spooky.
